title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Self-Calibration
authors_zh: Chengsong Huang、Langlin Huang、Jiaxin Huang（华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校）；Jixuan Leng（卡内基梅隆大学）；Jiacheng Liu（华盛顿大学）
paper_type_zh: 置信度校准测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 希望减少固定最佳候选采样成本的读者。
one_line: Self-Calibration distills self-consistency confidence into one forward pass, enabling confidence-based early stopping for sampling.
自校准将自一致性置信度蒸馏到单次前向传播，使采样可以依据置信度早停。
why: It turns calibrated confidence into an online compute-allocation signal.
inclusion_reason: It uses a self-calibrated confidence signal to stop or continue sampling under a test-time budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fixed Best-of-N spends the same samples on easy and hard prompts. Raw verbal confidence is unreliable, so it cannot safely decide when sampling should stop.

The paper asks how to obtain a cheap confidence signal accurate enough to allocate sampling effort during inference.

固定最佳候选采样会在简单和困难提示上花费相同样本。原始语言置信度不可靠，无法安全决定何时停止采样。

论文研究如何获得足够便宜且准确的置信度信号，以便在推理时分配采样工作量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Self-consistency provides a more reliable confidence target than one model declaration. The method distills that target into the model so one forward pass can estimate confidence.

The calibrated score controls early stopping and confidence-aware aggregation, concentrating samples where uncertainty remains high.

自一致性比一次模型声明提供更可靠的置信度目标。方法把该目标蒸馏进模型，使一次前向传播即可估计置信度。

校准分数控制早停和置信度感知聚合，把样本集中在不确定性仍高的位置。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors derive supervision from self-consistency across sampled answers, then train a calibration model to predict it. At deployment, calibrated confidence decides whether Best-of-N continues or stops.

They compare direct confidence, fixed sampling, and calibrated early stopping across three LLMs and six datasets.

作者从多个采样答案的自一致性导出监督，再训练校准模型预测它。部署时，校准置信度决定最佳候选采样继续还是停止。

他们在三种语言模型和六个数据集上比较直接置信度、固定采样和校准早停。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On MathQA with a 16-response budget, confidence-based early stopping raises reported accuracy from 81.0% to 83.6%. The paper reports consistent efficiency gains across six datasets.

The evidence supports calibration rather than raw confidence: the latter is overconfident, while self-consistency-derived targets improve the stopping signal.

在 16 个回答预算的 MathQA 上，基于置信度的早停将报告准确率从 81.0% 提高到 83.6%。论文报告该效率增益在六个数据集上保持一致。

证据支持校准而非原始置信度：后者过度自信，而自一致性导出的目标改善了停止信号。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The key novelty is treating self-consistency as distillation supervision for an online allocation score. It avoids repeatedly sampling merely to estimate confidence.

This makes calibration a serving primitive: one pass predicts whether additional inference is worthwhile.

关键新意是把自一致性作为在线分配分数的蒸馏监督，避免只为估计置信度而反复采样。

这使校准成为服务原语：一次前向传播预测额外推理是否值得。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method assumes self-consistency is a useful supervision target and can fail under distribution shift or systematic shared errors. Thresholds still need validation for a target model and workload.
方法假设自一致性是有用监督目标，在分布偏移或系统性共享错误下可能失效。阈值仍需针对目标模型和工作负载验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when fixed sample counts dominate inference cost and a model can be calibrated before deployment. Measure both accuracy and actual saved samples after applying early stopping.
当固定样本数主导推理成本且模型可在部署前校准时，可使用该工作。应用早停后应同时测量准确率和实际节省样本数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the calibration analysis before using the MathQA headline. The important question is whether confidence remains calibrated on the intended prompt distribution.
在使用 MathQA 醒目结果前，应先阅读校准分析。关键问题是置信度在目标提示分布上是否仍保持校准。
